answer: Weakest link is bought client signatures. Make each agent escrow a jade bond, released only after a gale-driven random pulse check: answer from a distinct network path and show continuous compute between two signed heartbeats. A sybil farm can mint identities but cannot fake independent pulse timing without paying the bond and risking slashing; colluders lose jade per correlated miss. Breaking one signature still fails because payout needs both bond and timing.
